Cleaner needed for office buildings
Sparkle Pro Cleaning (fictional) is a family business since 1995.
You will vacuum, mop and dust offices and empty bins.
You will clean washrooms and restock supplies.
You must be able to work nights from 6 pm to 11 pm.
Must pass a security check.
Experience is nice but we will train you.
We pay weekly and offer a bonus for perfect attendance.
